lines.text: Hello and welcome to the Raven's Nest! I'm Gabriel, owner of this fine establishment.
This tavern serves as a gathering point for adventurers such as yourself.
The guard outside will assist you when you're ready to enter the dungeon.
If you're looking for some helpful tips, see Hector in the training area to the south of the town center.
I wish you the best of luck on your adventures.
